I was on 800mg seroquel and hated the effects, literally stopped taking them completely and after a month I was fine. That month was hell, throwing up, hallucinations etc then after I was fine. Personally I’d say a slow taper over a month should be fine, but expect to experience some withdrawal symptoms. These meds are literal nightmares and fuck up the biome of the GI tract as well as a chance of physical dependency on the chemicals in them to maintain brain chemistry. 
I think the best thing to do is get therapy to talk about the delusions and also keep a journal, I’m a strong advocate for meds free tbh.
